remarks: Be the first to occupy this newly renovated, thoughtfully designed, two story apartment in a perfect location. Enter this lovely apartment to find beautiful upgrades, including new kitchen cabinets, countertops, and backsplash. New stainless appliances, luxury vinyl planking, an updated 1/2 bath, plus a stackable washer dryer hidden behind a custom sliding barn door provides both style and convenience. Sliding doors to the private back deck for entertaining and relaxing complete the main level. Upstairs find 2 bedrooms also with new flooring and a modernized full bathroom. 3 parking spaces plus a storage unit included for your convenience. Transportation is a breeze with close proximity to the bus, train station, and I-95. Electricity, water and trash are included.
